name: Flipside Lords
description: Based on The Duke. Two lords fight on a 6×6 board with troop tiles. Each tile shows a movement grid, and after it acts it flips to its other side, which has a different grid. On your turn either move one tile using its grid (move, jump, slide, strike from afar, or command a nearby troop), or draw a random troop from your bag and place it beside your Lord. You may never leave your Lord where it could be taken next turn. If your rival cannot make a safe move, you win. Setup: each Lord starts in the middle of its home row with two Footmen beside it.

ui_instructions: Setup: tap a glowing square for your Lord, then two squares beside it for your Footmen. Play: tap one of your tiles to see its moves (green ring: move, red ring: capture, red star: strike from afar, blue diamond: command), then tap a highlight. To bring in a troop, press Draw a troop and tap a square beside your Lord. Select a tile and use the flip tool (or press F) to see its other side.

cases.name: Moving a tile flips it to its other side
cases.description: Based on The Duke. Two lords fight on a 6×6 board with troop tiles. Each tile shows a movement grid, and after it acts it flips to its other side, which has a different grid. On your turn either move one tile using its grid (move, jump, slide, strike from afar, or command a nearby troop), or draw a random troop from your bag and place it beside your Lord. You may never leave your Lord where it could be taken next turn. If your rival cannot make a safe move, you win. Setup: each Lord starts in the middle of its home row with two Footmen beside it.

cases.name: Drawing a troop places it beside the Lord
cases.description: Based on The Duke. Two lords fight on a 6×6 board with troop tiles. Each tile shows a movement grid, and after it acts it flips to its other side, which has a different grid. On your turn either move one tile using its grid (move, jump, slide, strike from afar, or command a nearby troop), or draw a random troop from your bag and place it beside your Lord. You may never leave your Lord where it could be taken next turn. If your rival cannot make a safe move, you win. Setup: each Lord starts in the middle of its home row with two Footmen beside it.

cases.name: A strike captures from afar without moving
cases.description: Based on The Duke. Two lords fight on a 6×6 board with troop tiles. Each tile shows a movement grid, and after it acts it flips to its other side, which has a different grid. On your turn either move one tile using its grid (move, jump, slide, strike from afar, or command a nearby troop), or draw a random troop from your bag and place it beside your Lord. You may never leave your Lord where it could be taken next turn. If your rival cannot make a safe move, you win. Setup: each Lord starts in the middle of its home row with two Footmen beside it.

cases.name: A command moves another troop; only the commander flips
cases.description: Based on The Duke. Two lords fight on a 6×6 board with troop tiles. Each tile shows a movement grid, and after it acts it flips to its other side, which has a different grid. On your turn either move one tile using its grid (move, jump, slide, strike from afar, or command a nearby troop), or draw a random troop from your bag and place it beside your Lord. You may never leave your Lord where it could be taken next turn. If your rival cannot make a safe move, you win. Setup: each Lord starts in the middle of its home row with two Footmen beside it.

cases.description: Based on The Duke. Two lords fight on a 6×6 board with troop tiles. Each tile shows a movement grid, and after it acts it flips to its other side, which has a different grid. On your turn either move one tile using its grid (move, jump, slide, strike from afar, or command a nearby troop), or draw a random troop from your bag and place it beside your Lord. You may never leave your Lord where it could be taken next turn. If your rival cannot make a safe move, you win. Setup: each Lord starts in the middle of its home row with two Footmen beside it.

es.short_description: Basado en The Duke. Dos señores luchan en un tablero de 6×6 con fichas de tropa. ar.short_description: مبنية على The Duke. سيدان يتقاتلان على لوح 6×6 ببلاطات الجنود. تحمل كل بلاطة شبكة حركة، وبعد أن تتحرك تنقلب إلى وجهها الآخر بشبكة مختلفة. في دورك حرّك بلاطة وفق شبكتها (تحرك، قفز، انزلاق، ضربة من بعيد، أو أمر لجندي قريب)، أو اسحب جنديًا عشوائيًا من كيسك وضعه بجانب سيدك. لا يجوز أن تترك سيدك حيث يمكن أسره في الدور التالي. إذا لم يكن لخصمك أي حركة آمنة فأنت الفائز. البداية: يبدأ كل سيد في وسط صفه الخلفي ومعه جنديا مشاة بجانبه.

ar.game_ui_rules: البداية: المس مربعًا مضيئًا لسيدك، ثم مربعين بجانبه لجنديي المشاة. اللعب: المس إحدى بلاطاتك لترى حركاتها (حلقة خضراء: تحرك، حلقة حمراء: أسر، نجمة حمراء: ضربة من بعيد، معين أزرق: أمر)، ثم المس مربعًا مضيئًا. لإدخال جندي اضغط اسحب جنديًا والمس مربعًا بجانب سيدك. حدد بلاطة واستخدم أداة القلب (أو F) لرؤية وجهها الآخر.
